# RC38 — Local symbol occurrence navigation

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- `Esc c .` jumps to the next exact identifier-boundary occurrence of the symbol under the cursor in the current buffer.
- `Esc c ,` jumps to the previous exact identifier-boundary occurrence of the symbol under the cursor in the current buffer.
- Occurrence navigation wraps at file boundaries, ignores partial-token matches, and records jump history for `JumpBack`.
- Single-occurrence and no-identifier cases report explicit status without opening a picker or mutating text.
- The Code namespace help now exposes `./, Occur` alongside completion, actions, definition, references, problems, and rename.
- README and iPad QA docs now include the occurrence-navigation behavior and updated proof counts.
